text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The first crown of the Triple Tiara! 
Claiming the crown adorned with cherry 
blossoms is— Still in Love!

Still in Love successfully tapped into her 
instincts and secured a brilliant victory 
without losing control. However—
(Waaaaaaaaaaaaaaah...!!)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Fufufufufufu...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, no... I can't... Just a little 
longer... hold it in...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Please... act lady-like...! Everyone is 
watching—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love was incredible...! I thought 
she was a reserved girl... but she was 
like a completely different person out 
there!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"It was like... well, honestly... she 
almost looked like a completely different 
person..."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Btw! Admire Groove was pretty good too, 
right? Seemed like she was tensing up a 
bit this time, though...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. The Oaks is 2,400 meters... Given 
her style, doesn't that seem like a better 
fit!?

Expectations for Admire Groove continue to 
run high. That is simply how brilliantly 
her raw talent shines through—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I lost.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"She is stronger. ...Right now, at least. 
But..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I won't let anyone say that this is the 
right thing."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...The 'Oaks,' without fail.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Oh! Admire Groove is back! Photo op—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Wait, Alve!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Hm? That is... the "Empress," Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
You're right. ...Cheering on her juniors? 
She's looking out for others as always.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"You've still got dirt on your back. Come 
here."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"You have a press conference after this, 
right? You'll be standing before the 
public, so you ought to look the part."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Everyone will have their eyes on you for 
the next Oaks. Times like this call for 
holding your head high—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ah! ...Wait, there's mud on the hem too—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
...Juniors, or should I say... those two 
seem to have an even closer bond. Come to 
think of it, their hairstyles and vibes 
are pretty similar too.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
...It's true. If this works out... it 
could really blow up.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Guess I'll take a quick photo...

After the race, I praised her warmly once 
she suppressed her nearly runaway 
instincts and finally calmed down. I 
praised her with all my heart to remind 
her that she was the star.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much...!
choice_data_list:
We managed to draw out that instinct 
nicely too, huh.

We managed to draw out that instinct 
nicely too, didn't we.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: It looks that way, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
The audience didn't notice it either, 
so...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"As I thought, that place was simply too 
stimulating... I believe there were a few 
dangerous moments."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I just ran with reckless 
abandon... and somehow managed to win.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Are you happy?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...! Please give me some advice for 
the Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"I don't want to lose this momentum. 
Please, teach me...!"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
What must I do to claim the second 
tiara...?

Today's victory seems to have boosted her 
confidence. If she can properly draw out 
her instincts, she displays incredible 
ability. My concern, however, is—
choice_data_list:
I want to think carefully about moving up 
in distance.

text_block_list.text:
"The Oaks is longer than today. If I let 
my guard down the moment I take a 
breather, my instincts might ensnare me."
choice_data_list:
Let's be even more conscious of taking a 
breather than usual.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"I will surely... claim victory in the 
Oaks as well."

The second crown of the Tiara route... The 
road to the Oaks has already begun.
